golden_set.reason: No independently signed and checked golden corpus

limitations: Only Telegram alert observations are measured, not all market moves
Historical formats before V4 deployment are excluded from live coverage denominator
One 1x2 message contains correlated 1x2, AH and Total tables, not three independent alerts
At least approximately 299 independently complete messages per family are needed for 99% lower 95% confidence with zero failures
The source of identity and parser revision may be unverified for records captured before provenance support
No 24h clean-log claim without evidence from all collection runs
Field agreement excludes invalid or absent values; complete_pct includes those failures
A manual golden set of original Telegram messages is required before any statistical certification

log_evidence.reason: 24h window unfinished or executed runs not all verified

collection_coverage.meaning: Telegram alert messages in the window that have a V4 record

extraction_exactness.reason: Agreement between two parsers of the same text is not exactness

movement_independence.reason: 1X2 and Total messages of one move are correlated; unit is the match

quality_dimensions.note: Informational dimensions. They do not change acceptance_gates or status.

parser_agreement.caveat: 100% on available fields is not global accuracy; both parsers read the same text
parser_agreement.meaning: V4 explicit values equal to the H1 record, per message, on available fields
parser_agreement.parser_period_assignment: observed_at vs main merge time of parser changes; approximate

provenance_window.reason: First 24h after the first V4 record with parser provenance; separates the transitional records without provenance. Records are never rewritten.

requires: about 299 independent messages per family with 0 failures

trigger_displayed_pct.reason: Displayed % does not follow (after-before)/before; keep as shown only
